items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then working with Specks Red on Tuesday nights, that taught me how to swing, how to play music.

ctx.x: The first arrangement I wrote was a thing called Little Sireco [spelling?]. I wrote it for big band. When I think about that – that arrangement was kind of lousy, but I had to go through that phase. I had a chance to listen to all those bands. That’s what really gave me the incentive. Then working with Specks Red on Tuesday nights, that taught me how to swing, how to play music.
When you say Specks Red, Specks Red’s band, was it a black band? white band? mixed band?
